messages:
maria: Thinking of running a ‘Mezz Mini-Olympics’ next Friday after standup. quick arcade rotations, speed-run challenge, and a meme award. whos down? :trophy: :joystick:

tony: love the name. Ill bring my retro USB arcade stick and a stack of meme stickers for the award. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

lee: count me in if theres a speed-run slot. I can do a brief Celeste time trial.

ari: i vote we add a 3-minute indie dev showcase where folks can demo tiny games they love. also ill handle sound system.

maria: voted. also quick poll: pizza, bao, or salad? drop emoji below so snack-bot can order.

tony: :pizza:

lee: :bao:

ari: :salad:

snack-bot: Poll closed: pizza wins. Ordering Margherita + one vegan. ETA 6:20pm. Link: https://kitchen/po/2145009999

maria: logistics: mezz projector + big table reserved. please bring any adapters; the projector prefers HDMI-A. also bring a power strip if you need extra plugs.

tony: FYI the mezz has a wall poster of the old hack-day setup thats hopped around. can we move it for projector sight-lines?

maria: good call. ill put a sticky note and ask facilities.

lee: bracket idea: 8-player free-for-all on Smash then quick 1v1 ladder. short matches so folks rotate.

ari: ill make a tiny Google form to sign up time slots so we dont bottleneck the TV. will post link tomorrow.

tony: meme award criteria: most chaotic play + best reaction GIF. ill DJ and queue up reaction sounds. :laughing:

maria: perfect. final ask: RSVP here with what youre bringing (controller/console/snack) so i can finalize table layout.

lee: lee - monitor + Celeste speedrun

tony: tony - arcade stick + meme stickers + soundboard

ari: ari - sound system + sign-up form + small speaker mic

maria: maria - projector + power strips + event coord

snack-bot: Event created: "Mezz Mini-Olympics" Fri 18:30. Calendar: https://calendar.company/evt/2145009999

maria: sweet. see yll next Friday, hype! :sparkles:
